events.title: Karaoke Night at The Orange Lantern
events.description: Karaoke is back on Monday nights at this classic Paramus sports bar, so grab the mic and a pint.

events.title: Grateful Tuesday at The Orange Lantern
events.description: A weekly Grateful Dead night with a rotating cast of Dead tribute bands (Dead to the Core on Nov 10, Mighty Quinn on Nov 17, Baked Alaska on Nov 24).

events.title: Music Bingo at The Orange Lantern
events.description: Bingo played with song clips instead of numbers, a fun midweek night out. No Music Bingo on Nov 25.

events.title: Trivia Night at The Orange Lantern
events.description: Joe Trivia hosts free team trivia with prizes every Thursday. No trivia on Thanksgiving (Nov 26) or Christmas Eve (Dec 24).

events.title: Live Bands at The Orange Lantern
events.description: Local cover bands rock the room most weekends: Dirty Rotten Bastid (Nov 13), InterCity 125 (Nov 14), Afterparty (Nov 20), Rewind Theory (Nov 21), Billy Monroe & The Soul Survivors (Dec 5), The Rummies (Dec 12), Fuzzy Dice (Dec 26) and more.

events.title: Darts Night at The Orange Lantern
events.description: Luck of the Draw darts on Sunday nights: show up, get paired, play and win.

events.title: Trivia Night at Stone & Rail
events.description: Tuesday trivia at Glen Rock's gastropub, which also runs Teacher Tuesday specials from 4 PM to close.

events.title: Industry Night at Stone & Rail
events.description: A Monday late-night hang aimed at restaurant and bar workers, after a regular 4-6 PM happy hour.

events.title: Happy Hour at Stone & Rail
events.description: Weekday happy hour at the bar of this Glen Rock gastropub near the train line.

events.title: Friday Live Music at Stone & Rail
events.time_text: Live Music 5 PM - 8 PM; Live Local Bands 8:30 PM - 11:30PM
events.description: Two rounds of music every Friday: an early set from 5 to 8 PM and local bands from 8:30 PM, with the bar open until about 1 AM.

events.title: Country Wednesday for Veterans Day at Stone & Rail
events.description: The Black Book Band plays country covers for a Veterans Day celebration. Free admission.

events.title: Live Music at Steel Wheel Tavern
events.location: Steel Wheel Tavern, 51 N Broad St
events.time_text: Usually 6 PM; second sets 9:30 PM on Fri & Sat
events.description: Downtown Ridgewood's go-to for live local music, with acoustic acts and cover bands like The Faculty Meeting, John Lepre, That's What She Sang and PaperJam on the calendar.

events.title: Live Bands at The Shannon Rose
events.description: Weekend cover bands at this big Irish pub on Route 17: Mr. Lovejoy (Nov 13), ARENA (Nov 14), 8th Grade Science (Nov 20), The Georgia 5 80s Dance Party (Nov 21), The Benjamins (Nov 27), The Bergen Boys (Nov 28) and Kickin' Nash (Dec 12).

events.title: Happy Hour at The Shannon Rose
events.description: One of the area's more generous happy hours, running all day Monday, plus a late-night window Monday-Thursday from 10pm to close.

events.title: Open Mic Night at Five Dimes Brewery
events.description: Bring an instrument or just a pint and cheer on local performers at downtown Westwood's brewery.

events.title: Trivia Night at Five Dimes Brewery
events.description: Joe Trivia runs free team trivia at the brewery every Wednesday; food is BYO.

events.title: Bingo Night at Five Dimes Brewery
events.description: Thursday bingo with a flight of house beers, an easy low-key night out.

events.title: Weekend Live Music at Five Dimes Brewery
events.description: Live bands on Friday and Saturday (After Party plays Nov 13). The brewery is 21+ after 8pm on weekends.

events.title: Trivia Night at Davey's Irish Pub
events.description: Monday Joe Trivia at Montvale's family-run Irish pub, open since 1974. Listed on the Joe Trivia schedule, not on the pub's own site.

events.title: Trivia Night at The Cornerstone
events.description: Free Tuesday trivia at Hillsdale's neighborhood bar, which stays open until 2-3 AM.

events.title: Trivia Night at Allendale Bar & Grill
events.location: Allendale Bar & Grill, 67 W Allendale Ave
events.description: Free Joe Trivia that runs about two hours, with prizes for the top two teams.

events.title: Happy Hour at Allendale Bar & Grill
events.location: Allendale Bar & Grill, 67 W Allendale Ave
events.description: Bar-only weekday happy hour with drink deals and $8 appetizer plates.

events.title: Trivia Night at Doc Watson's
events.description: Tuesday trivia at Oakland's Irish pub. The pub lists Tuesday trivia, and Joe Trivia gives the 7pm start.

events.title: Trivia Night at Nellie's Place
events.description: Wednesday Joe Trivia at a thin-crust pizza spot with 13 beers on tap. Listed by Joe Trivia, not on the restaurant's site.

events.title: Trivia Night at JJ's Pub & Grill
events.description: Wednesday Joe Trivia at a family-run Fair Lawn pub that has been around for over 45 years. Listed by Joe Trivia.

events.title: Trivia Night at Mahwah Bar & Grill
events.description: Late-starting Wednesday Joe Trivia in Mahwah. Listed by Joe Trivia; the venue's own page wasn't reachable.

events.title: Trivia Night at Midland Brew House
events.location: Midland Brew House, 374 North Midland Avenue
events.description: Tuesday Joe Trivia at a two-floor sports lounge with 60-plus TVs. Listed by Joe Trivia.

events.title: Trivia Night at Houlihan's Ramsey
events.description: Tuesday Joe Trivia at Houlihan's in Ramsey. Listed by Joe Trivia.

events.title: Trivia Night at Houlihan's Paramus
events.description: Wednesday Joe Trivia at Houlihan's in Paramus. Listed by Joe Trivia.

events.description: Tuesday Joe Trivia at the Paramus Miller's Ale House. Listed by Joe Trivia.

events.title: Trivia Night at Plank Pizza Co.

events.description: Thursday Joe Trivia at a brick-oven Italian tavern. Listed by Joe Trivia.

events.title: Trivia Night at Gotham City Diner
events.description: Thursday trivia with prizes at a big Fair Lawn diner, an easygoing alternative to a bar night.

events.title: Trivia Night at MacMurphy's
events.description: Tuesday Joe Trivia in Ridgewood. Listed by Joe Trivia, but the pub's website no longer works, so call ahead.

events.title: Open Mic Night at Booyah!

events.title: Thanksgiving Trivia Night at Booyah!

events.title: Billy Doors Petty! at Booyah!
events.description: One band covering Billy Joel, The Doors and Tom Petty in a single night.

events.title: Lotion Holiday Party Show at Booyah!
events.description: Booyah's holiday-party special with the band Lotion, running until midnight.

events.title: New Year's Eve Party at Booyah!

events.title: Music Bingo at Booyah!
events.description: Free music bingo with prizes. Sing along and mark your card over dinner and drinks.

events.title: Weekend Live Bands at Mason Jar

events.description: A Grateful Dead and Jerry Garcia Band tribute to start the new year.

events.title: 80s Dance Party with The Georgia 5 at The Shannon Rose
events.description: The Georgia 5 bring an 80s dance party to the Irish pub's stage.

events.title: Live Music Saturdays at The Emerson Hotel
events.description: Live bands every Saturday at this historic bar and steakhouse, open since 1872: til we can't (Nov 14), 5 equals (Nov 21), no hard feelings (Nov 28), the stone birds (Dec 5), blue collar band (Dec 12), summer breeze (Dec 19).

events.title: Karaoke Tuesday at Blue 42

events.description: $8 wings (dine-in only) from a menu of 196 flavors, a cheap and fun midweek night.

events.title: Happy Hour at Blue 42
events.description: Weekday dine-in happy hour. On Mondays the doors open at 4PM.
